excerpts:
# Terminal-Bench 4.0
Calibrating task resources, fixing tasks, and removing saturated tasks
We've pushed a version update to the Terminal-Bench dataset and leaderboard. Terminal-Bench 4.0 calibrates task resources (time, CPU, memory), implements task fixes, and removes saturated tasks.

...

## Removing and fixing tasks
We fixed 19 tasks, updating instructions, environments, and verifiers to address flakiness or misspecification reported by users or found in our leaderboard runs.

...

## Acknowledgements
The leaderboard experiments are supported with grants from OpenAI, Anthropic, Z.ai, SpaceX AI, and Laude Institute.
Special thanks to Gian Segato, who devised the resource calibration methodology and ran the calibration experiments.
Everything in this blog post is derived from [Terminal-Bench 4.0 data](https://hub.harborframework.com/datasets/terminal-bench/terminal-bench/latest?tab=leaderboard&leaderboard=4-0-0) stored on the Harbor Hub
Written by
[Ryan Marten](https://github.com/ryanmarten)

**Reading the expanded table:** The 58.2% top-stat remains the highest public tbench.ai submission. Public-board Opus 5 now scores 53.9% ±3.2 at xhigh (rank #3; 6.9B tokens, $6.1k run cost). Grok 4.7 is a public-board row at #6 (37.6% ±3.5).
